recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32342 unless a future work group decision separately changes EncounterHistory or the Encounter.class binding/cardinality.
issue_request: FHIR-32342 was a Published PA change request, resolved Persuasive and applied for R5, asking for Encounter.class to be updated from Coding to CodeableConcept so translations and text can be represented like other coded elements.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by commit b40b0800fbe4673331bc561a03dca9162b60c594, which changed source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml from Coding to CodeableConcept for Encounter.class. Commit eae372965195eb758a60ed415941bbfb2b37ec07 updated dependent examples, and both changes were merged through HL7/fhir#1930 as e83be66111256dc255e651e111739d7066f5704d.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml the current build-scope authority. Later FHIR-14157 Encounter reorganization removed the old classHistory backbone from core and does not create a current Encounter.class gap. Zulip implementation notices from the original editor corroborate the example updates, and direct Confluence reference search found no FHIR-32342 minutes or pages changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already has Encounter.class as 0..* CodeableConcept with the EncounterClass preferred binding.

related_jiras.note: Later Encounter reorganization removed Encounter.classHistory from the core Encounter resource; it was checked as context but is not part of this datatype request.
